subject: DEFAULT ROUNDED clause
notes: cite.py --check 11.9.6.3 "The DEFAULT ROUNDED clause specifies the type of rounding that applies to any explicit ROUNDED phrase that does not include an explicit MODE phrase" -> OK §11.9.6.3 1); companion §11.9.6.1 "ROUNDED phrases of arithmetic statements, SOURCE clauses, and SUM clauses do not specify a rounding mode" -> OK; §14.7.4.3 r1 "If the MODE phrase is not specified, the form of rounding is as described in 11.9.6, DEFAULT ROUNDED clause" -> OK; §11.9.4 r1 (inheritance into contained source elements, override by a contained OPTIONS) -> OK.
